blocks.text: The reality of daily media planning on Mac

Your day as a media planner is a mix of data analysis and high volume communication. You likely spend most of your time in spreadsheets or agency dashboards. You also spend hours in Outlook or Gmail. The struggle is balancing creative strategy with the constant need to update status reports and internal teams. This administrative burden often eats into your time for deep work.
How media planning software tools fit your workflow

Most media planners rely on a specific set of tools to stay organized on macOS. You probably use Excel or Google Sheets for reach and frequency calculations. You might use Asana or Trello for task management. You also use Apple Calendar to block out time for deep work. The problem is that switching between these apps creates friction. You lose time finding the right menu or remembering a specific formula.
Using Lazur to manage your Mac workspace

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in the notch of your Mac. You hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask questions about what is on your screen. You can ask where a specific setting is in Excel. Lazur draws a circle and a label around the button. You can ask how to perform a complex task. Lazur guides you one click at a time. This keeps you in your flow state.
Common mistakes when planning media campaigns

Many planners get stuck in the weeds of manual data entry. They spend hours updating rows in a spreadsheet that could be automated. Another mistake is failing to document the logic behind a campaign. When you need to explain your reach and frequency choices later, you struggle to find the original data. Use Lazur to dictate your notes directly into your project management tool. This captures your thinking in real time.

As a media professional, you handle sensitive client data and budget information. Lazur respects your privacy. It only listens and looks at your screen when you hold the shortcut key. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models. Always follow your employer's rules regarding client data and data security. Lazur is a tool to help you work, not a replacement for your professional judgment.

If you are ready to reclaim your day from admin tasks, start by looking at your current software tools. Are they helping you or slowing you down? If you find yourself clicking through menus to find basic functions, try using a voice assistant to help you navigate. This simple change can save you minutes every hour. Over a week, that adds up to hours of extra time for strategy.
